detail: The independent auditor's report on the consolidated and parent financial statements of the Brunei Darussalam Central Bank and its subsidiary for the year ended 31 December 2025, addressed to the Board of Directors, is on PricewaterhouseCoopers letterhead and signed for PricewaterhouseCoopers Services by Chai Xiang Yuin, Partner, in Brunei Darussalam on 3 June 2026. It adds that the accounting and other records required by the Act have been properly kept. The report pages carry no machine-readable text, so this was read from the rendered page.
source_title: Annual Report 2025, independent auditor's report (Brunei Darussalam Central Bank)
